ymyl_contradiction_resolution.resolution: No government-primary source (MFA/embassy/Bank of Thailand) could be directly read in this environment. Found and WebFetch-confirmed a strong institutional secondary source instead: Siam Legal International, a licensed, named Thailand immigration law firm (not a Muay Thai niche competitor, so citable directly per brief rule). Its DTV guide explicitly lists stock/investment portfolios AND cryptocurrency as 'commonly rejected' proof of funds, matching the majority/best-sourced competitor position (2/3) and directly contradicting the lone dissenting page. Article uses this as the deciding citation, with an explicit disclaimer in the Sources section that this is a law firm confirmation, not a directly verified government source, and to check with the embassy for individual cases.
